questions: Have you had any sudden loss or blurring of vision in either eye?
Do you have eye pain, especially pain with eye movement?
Is the eye red, swollen, or producing pus?
Has one eye appeared to bulge or protrude more than the other?
Did these eye symptoms begin suddenly?
Have you had any recent injury or surgery involving the eye?
Do you have a history of thyroid disease?
Have you recently experienced weight loss, heat intolerance, tremors, or a racing heartbeat?
Do you have difficulty fully closing the affected eye?
Have you noticed a drooping eyelid or unequal pupils?
Have you had similar episodes before?
